title: WorkspaceBindResponse
description:
`workspace.bind` success response — the daemon validated and materialized (or already holds) a binding for the project.

Carries only project-safe fields; the local `candidate_path` is never echoed.

display.description: Redacted display metadata safe for hosted-bridge exposure.

project_id.description: The project the binding was materialized for.

state.description: Durable state after the successful bind (`local_workspace_bound`).

ProjectSafeDisplayMetadata.description:
Redacted, project-safe display metadata for a binding proposal.

SAFE to cross the hosted bridge: contains no local filesystem path, provider secret, source body, or event-store body. Any folder hint here must be a non-path label (e.g. a basename), never an absolute path.

candidate_label.description: Optional non-path folder label to help a human recognize the candidate (e.g. the folder basename only). MUST NOT be an absolute path.

display_name.description: Human-readable project display name. No path/remote/secret leakage.

project_slug.description: Optional short project slug/label. Safe, opaque display token.

WorkspaceBindingState.description:
Durable local workspace binding lifecycle state.

These are the only durable workspace states. `WorkspaceBindingProposal` is a transient protocol object, not a state in this enum.

oneOf.description: Project is registered but has no local workspace binding yet.
Project has a materialized local workspace binding.
A previously usable binding is broken and must be repaired before use.
